csv_scope_of_work: The City of Redlands ( City ) invites proposals from qualified firms to provide professional on-call general engineering services to support the City s Capital Improvement Program ( CIP ). While the City has an engineering division to design CIP projects, it periodically needs assistance with the design and deliverables for those projects.

title: On-Call General Engineering Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary engineering services supporting the City of Redlands capital improvement program.

services: Professional on-call general engineering services, including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering. Up to two contracts may be awarded for a 24-month non-renewable base period.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call engineering services without a defined specific structure or project.
- Target market is streets/highways, but no bridge, long-span, special structure, or building of interest is identified.
- Includes structural engineering among several disciplines, yet the scope is broad and non-specific.
- Low strategic fit for sbp because it is a general municipal support contract rather than a clearly defined structural design opportunity.

fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is stated for the on-call services contract.
